name: Franz
kurzbeschreibung: Franz is or was a small bar at Dorfstraße 17 in 6363 Westendorf in the Kitzbühel district in Tyrol; the establishment is now closed.
beschreibung: The entry Franz refers via the coordinates 47.4331749, 12.215699 unambiguously to Dorfstraße 17 in 6363 Westendorf in the Kitzbühel district – not to the town of Kitzbühel. In OpenStreetMap this point is recorded as a bar named “Franz”. Restaurant directories list the “FRANZ Cafè BAR” on Westendorf's Dorfstraße, which is now considered permanently closed. An official website, email address or telephone number of the establishment could not be verified. At the same address, the holiday apartment “Franz by Miha” is now offered, which belongs to Haus Veronika in Westendorf. Westendorf lies in the Brixental valley in the Kitzbüheler Alpen and belongs to the Kitzbühel district. Since the former bar is no longer in operation, contact details and opening hours remain empty.
